review.tagline: Chinese-language course on building LLM agents from scratch
review.summary: A 16-chapter Chinese tutorial from Datawhale covering agent fundamentals, ReAct, Plan-and-Solve and Reflection, low-code platforms (Coze, Dify, n8n) and frameworks (AutoGen, AgentScope, LangGraph). Later chapters build a custom framework on the OpenAI API and cover memory, RAG, context engineering, MCP/A2A/ANP, Agentic-RL (SFT to GRPO) and evaluation. Chapter code is in the repo's code folder.
review.audience: Python developers and students learning to build LLM agents, Chinese readers
strengths: 16 chapters from theory to capstone, with runnable code in the code folder
Includes an Agentic-RL chapter going from SFT to GRPO training
Builds a custom agent framework on the OpenAI API, not only framework usage
Free online reading and PDF download, plus extra chapters on interviews and skills
weaknesses: Written in Chinese; an English README is linked separately
License is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, which bars commercial use
Assumes basic Python and experience calling an LLM API
Hardware and model requirements for the exercises are unknown
